_help: Reality checks applied on top of FCC data. Station keys are CALL or CALL@kHz. Fields: off (true), keep (true: keep a Mexican station the CRT license list doesn't show), site ([lat, lon] for every slot), kw (replace licensed power: a number, or {"D": .., "N": ..} per slot), adjust_db (add dB to the field), note (shown in the explorer). Country entries take adjust_db/off/note and apply to every station from that country unless the station has its own entry. Top-level "add" lists stations the FCC has no record of: call, freq, city, state, country, site [lat, lon], kw {"D": .., "N": ..} (non-directional; omit a slot the station doesn't run), note.

CU.note: Cuban powers are old FCC listings, not current notifications; grid failures keep many stations off or at reduced power.
